name: Hilton Worldwide Holdings
description: Hilton Worldwide Holdings is one of the largest global hospitality companies, operating a predominantly asset-light franchise and management model across 23+ brands from luxury to economy extended-stay. The vast majority of its revenue comes from franchise fees (a percentage of franchisee room revenue) and management fees (base fee on total revenue plus incentive fee on profitability) charged to third-party hotel owners, plus licensing fees from strategic partners including co-branded credit card issuers and Hilton Grand Vacations. A small Ownership segment consists of hotels Hilton owns or leases directly, which behaves more like a traditional hotel-REIT economics. Growth is driven by net unit growth (new hotel openings from a large global development pipeline) and by systemwide RevPAR gains, with the Hilton Honors loyalty program central to driving direct bookings and franchisee value.

employees.note: Approximate total team members across the system: ~182,000 at Hilton-managed/owned properties and ~328,000 employed by third-party owners at franchised properties; Hilton's own corporate/directly-employed headcount is a small fraction of this system total

businessLines.name: Management and Franchise
businessLines.description: Franchise and licensing fees charged to third-party hotel owners, base and incentive management fees for hotels Hilton operates on behalf of owners, and licensing fees from strategic partners such as co-branded credit card issuers and Hilton Grand Vacations.

businessLines.name: Ownership
businessLines.description: Revenue from the small number of hotels Hilton owns or leases directly (46 hotels, 15,287 rooms as of year-end 2025) — nightly room sales, food & beverage, and other on-site services, reported gross rather than as a fee.
